messages:
ashley: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for Elysian Dedicated outage (VPC peering flap + on‑prem isolation bug). I collected action items from yesterday's retro and laid out owners/timelines. Pls ack and adjust if needed.

raj: Ack. I can take network ownership for the peering checklist.

maya: Adding CS context — Elysian is on a quarterly compliance window, they need remediation visibility by next Tue. Can we target that? :eyes:

ashley: Noted — timeline goal = next Tue (2026-04-06). If any item slips we'll notify customer.

oliver: For the isolation bug (KV cache eviction due to onprem proxy retries) I pushed a diagnostic patch last night. Logs showed repeated 504 -> 503 fallbacks. Patch reduces aggressive retry bursts. I will open PR with test vectors.

ashley: Perfect. Can you add the PR link in this thread when ready so SRE can schedule a canary?

oliver: Will do. Expected PR by EOD today.

raj: For the VPC peering side — found two recurring config mismatches in the BGP timers across Elysian's edge routers vs our peering appliance. Proposed fixes: standardize keepalive/timers and add a monitoring rule to alert on asymmetry longer than 30s. Owner: raj. ETA: 2026-04-04.

ashley: Owner + ETA noted.

maya: Customer asks for a simple runbook they can follow for their network ops team in case of future flaps. Can someone own a 1‑page runbook?

oliver: I can draft the runbook (network + onprem proxy checklist + local KV cache sanity steps). Will keep it 1 page. Owner: oliver. ETA: 2026-04-05.

raj: Also adding automated check: a daily peering validation job in our private deploy CI that runs bgp status queries and validates timers. I will create a ticket. Ticket: RI-9421.

ashley: Great — add links to the ticket and to the PRs.

ops-bot: Reminder: retro action item template due in 48h.

ashley: Action item summary (copy into customer-facing doc):
- Network: standardize BGP timers + monitoring rule (owner: raj, ETA: 2026-04-04, ticket RI-9421)
- Runtime: fix retry logic & KV eviction mitigation (owner: oliver, ETA: PR today, canary after merge)
- Runbook: 1‑page ops runbook for Elysian (owner: oliver, ETA: 2026-04-05)
- Customer comms: draft remediation summary + timeline (owner: maya, ETA: 2026-04-03)
- Postmortem followup cadence: add Elysian to monthly isolation-pattern review for 3 months (owner: sylvia, ETA: 2026-04-06)

sylvia: I can own the cadence addition and the 3‑month review. Will add it to the product incident cadence board and invite Elysian's lead.

maya: I'll draft the customer summary and include a short SLA impact note. Will post by 2026-04-03 noon PT.

raj: Quick config snippet for the BGP timers I'll commit to RI-9421:```
neighbor X.X.X.X timers 10 30
! keepalive 10s, hold 30s to match appliance
```

oliver: Can SRE run a canary after the PR? Suggested canary window: low traffic window Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC.

ashley: SRE schedule: i'll coordinate with oncall. sylvia/maya, if the customer needs a maintenance window we can align.

maya: Elysian confirmed Thu 03:00–04:00 UTC is OK for low-risk canary.

ashley: Next steps: owners update tickets/PRs with check-ins here. We'll close the thread once all items are either shipped or have a documented mitigation/owner reassign. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

oliver: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ri-runtime/pull/1487 (added test vectors + rollback flag). Requesting review.

raj: RI-9421 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RI-9421 — added validation job, monitoring rule draft.

maya: Customer-facing remediation summary draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/customer/elysian-remediation-draft.md — feedback welcome.

ashley: Great progress. Closing note: add a recurring alert for isolation pattern spikes (30d rolling window) to the incident board and link to the postmortem. sylvia can you attach?

sylvia: Done — linked on the incident board and added Elysian to the 3‑month review.

ashley: Thanks. I'll follow up if anything slips.

ops-bot: Action items snapshot saved to S3: s3://redwood-postmortems/elysian/2026-04-01/snapshot.json

ashley: Thread closed for now — reopen if any owner needs to escalate.
